description: Forages pour sonde géothermique verticale is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Geoinformation Kanton Freiburg. Les relevés géologiques originaux sont disponibles au format PDF sur le portail cartographique cantonal. Coverage: Geoinformation Kanton Freiburg. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use. It can support heat network planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
